title: Scientists Report Blood Traces in a 115-Million-Year-Old Dinosaur Bone
paragraphs: Scientists found something special in a dinosaur bone. The dinosaur lived 115 million years ago. It lived in Brazil.
Inside the bone, the scientists saw tiny red blood cells. They also found a chemical from blood. It helps blood carry air.
This is very old. The scientists say it is a big discovery. Now they want to learn more about old animals.
